text: {"lessons":["Selling B, D, and E at a gain felt satisfying, but I should make future decisions based on risk and expected return rather than the pleasure of locking in a profit.","I tend to judge each stock against my purchase price and resist admitting mistakes; I should assess every holding objectively, including whether I would buy it today.","I trade infrequently, and these modest account fluctuations do not make past price moves predictive; I should stay patient and avoid reacting to short-term noise."]}
